title: Camso Recalls Dirt to Snow Bike Conversion Kits Due to Crash and Impact Hazards
summary: The bolts on the brakes can loosen, posing a crash or impact hazard. Units: About 480 (In addition, 430 were sold in Canada).

title: Sandoz and Novartis Recall Prescription Drug Blister Packages Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirements
summary: The prescription drug packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a poisoning risk if swallowed by children. Units: About 470,000.

title: Crate and Barrel Recalls Mirrors Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The mirror's glass can separate from the wooden backing and fall, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 830.

title: Allura Recalls Children's Sleepwear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's pajamas fail to meet the flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 64,000.

title: Burton Recalls Snowboard Boots Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The boots can release from the binding unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 4,800.

title: ORTOVOX Recalls Avalanche Transceivers Due to Loss of Emergency Communications Capability
summary: The transceiver can fail to work properly due to a software error and fail to transmit the position of survivors of an avalanche, resulting in delayed search and rescue operations. Units: About 20,000 (In addition, about 7,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Additional Incidents Prompt Johnson Health Tech to Reannounce Recall of Matrix Fitness Ascent Trainers and Ellipticals Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Moisture from user perspiration or cleaning liquids can build up in the power socket on the unit, causing a short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,000 (The trainers and ellipticals were previously recalled in January 2014.).

title: Hirsch Gift Recalls Wireless Charging Pads Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The wireless phone chargers can overheat while in use, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 21,000.

title: Jimmy Hack Golf Recalls Golf Swing Trainers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The orange ball can detach from the trainer while in use, posing an injury hazard to the user and bystanders. Units: About 6,100.

title: Trek Recalls Bontrager Line Pro Bicycle Pedals Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The spindle of one or both of the pedals can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 9,630 pairs (in addition, 600 pairs were sold in Canada).

title: JCPenney Recalls Okie Dokie Denim Patches Shortie Shorts Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The patches on the shorts can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,400.

title: Ross Stores Recalls Bistro Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair's frame can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,300.
